$comment: The per-view, per-entity drift manifest (plan 01 §7; plan 05 §3.1 step 4) the in-call detector reads. Generated by scripts/gen-manifest.ts from the committed recorded fixtures (fixtures/espn/manifest.json, whose canonical sha256 is recording_manifest_sha256) — never hand-edited; regenerate after re-recording (`--check` tells whether it is current). Each view is observed over WHOLE responses (split parts re-assembled) recorded as that view alone, else inside a composite request. Patterns: `$` the root, `.key` a property, `[]` every array element, `{}` every value of a map-like object (every key an integer, or any key outside [A-Za-z_$][\w$]*). Per view: `observed` key sets, `enums` (UPPER_SNAKE strings outside free-text keys; statSourceId, statSplitTypeId, lineupSlotId, defaultPositionId, proTeamId), `array_lengths`, `nodes` and `optional` (keys some node lacks; every other observed key was on every node — a candidate for a required set, never more), `map_keys` (integer keys of map-like objects: stat ids, slot ids, weeks), and `entities` (team, member, rosterEntry, playerPoolEntry, player, stats, scheduleItem, matchupSide, settings.*, status, … — the same observations grouped per entity, keys relative to the entity node). `errors`: the recorded error bodies (synthetic bodies are never evidence and never here). Paths, keys and enum tokens only: no value, name or id of any league.
